7 انقضب It was, or became, cut, or cut off; (S, M, O, Msb, K;) and so ↓ تقضّب [but app. in an intensive sense or said of a number of things]. (M, K.) ―
-b2- And [hence] (tropical:) He became cut off, or separated, from his companions. (A.) ―
-b3- And, said of a star, (tropical:) It darted down (TA) from its place. (S, A, O.) Dhu-r-Rummeh says, (S, A, O,) describing a wild bull [i. e. a bovine antelope], (O,) “كَأَنَّهُ كَوْكَبٌ فِى إِثْرِ عِفْرِيَةٍ
↓ مُسَوَّمٌ فِى سَوَادِ اللَّيْلِ مُنْقَضِبُ
” [As though he were a star launched forth in the darkness of night, darting down after an evil demon]. (S, A, O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
